name: filesystem-extra

capabilities.fallback: use an explicitly scoped filesystem tool
capabilities.verification: inspect the resolved target path after each mutation

_comment: 可选 MCP（默认停用）：扩展文件系统访问。需在 env/secrets.json 增加 "filesystem_extra": { "root": "/abs/path/allowed" } 占位解析。启用：把 enabled 改为 true 或删除该字段。
